en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a town square with a baroque-style parish church with a tall clock tower at the center. To the left stands a building labeled 'Hotel Börse', and to the right a multi-storey rectory building labeled 'Kath. Pfarrhaus'. The scene is labeled with German captions including the town name 'Warnsdorf i. Böhm.' and the word 'Markt', indicating the market square.
